ff9a779e.task:
Perform comprehensive black-box reconnaissance on http://host.docker.internal:3100 to identify:
1. Application technology stack and framework
2. Authentication model and session management
3. All endpoints, API routes, and parameters
4. User roles and access levels
5. Frontend and backend technologies
6. Third-party services and integrations
7. Known vulnerabilities in identified technologies

Document the complete attack surface map and provide a detailed inventory of discovered endpoints and features. This will inform the threat model and guide subsequent vulnerability testing.
